outcomes.scope: Explicit setup stages and baseline-enforcement evidence remain separate from native/measurement/persistence gates. Missing or interrupted evidence is not a pass.

nativeExecution.scope: Exact runtime and raw-log lifecycle from preserved original artifacts; strict warning verification recorded separately. Model test execution order is recorded, not required to equal the selector-file order.

simulatorHitches.detail: XCTest emitted scroll duration and memory, but no animation hitch samples on this simulator. This run cannot evaluate frame hitches.

limits: Simulator evidence only. Hosted SQLite readback is verified from retained independent sidecar/report fields, not a second local raw database read. Structural sidecar success never substitutes for missing metrics or baseline acceptance.

timing.scope: Runner spans use first/last steps; job started_at is not execution time. Dependency/admission/provider wait remains combined unless retained snapshots prove boundaries.

scope: Setup receipts, native execution, metrics, saved-pickup structural readback and approved-baseline outcomes are separate gates.
Hosted SQLite report fields and exact attachment identities are verified; no raw app-ledger database downloaded.
All xcresulttool inspection used working copies, with original ZIPs and extracted members rehashed.
Earlier original804 setup failure and earlier missing-scroll-series failures remain preserved; setup success alone does not resolve a missing metric.
No retry, dispatch, source/Git edit or native app/test execution by collector.

scrollMetricSQLiteReadback.interpretation: Independent read-only copy of original XCTest result metadata, not app-ledger data. Current presence or absence does not rewrite historical failures or establish their cause.

limits: Previous runs have activity windows only; no retroactive measurement-call attribution.
The instrumented passing run is nonreproduction, not a fix or proof of causality.
Signpost pairs do not substitute for the required XCTest duration series.
Timestamp reads and buffering perturb timing. Public-call brackets are not internal XCTest collection boundaries.
Endpoint capture is bounded and cannot prove XCTest consumption or complete OS emission.
UTC anchors permit approximate correlation only; endpoint log precision and possible clock drift/jumps remain uncertain.
Observed first invocation is expected warm-up only after checking six-invocation shape; no sample is discarded or substituted.

endpointEvidence.timestampBasis: seconds from first enclosing swipe activity start; not measurement boundaries
endpointEvidence.ordering: captured log order; tokens preserve equality, not unique gesture identity

signpostSummary.windowBasis: enclosing swipe activity start to following activity start; not XCTest measurement boundaries

boundaryReceipt.clock: ProcessInfo.systemUptime seconds; UTC anchors are approximate
boundaryReceipt.invocationMapping: Zero-based observed order. First is expected warm-up only when six invocations complete; no sample is discarded here.
boundaryReceipt.limits: Clock reads and buffering perturb timing. Calls are bracketed, not XCTest internal collection boundaries. No duration-series substitution or acceptance claim.

clockCorrelation.limits: Intervals bracket each anchor only, not arbitrary intermediate wall-clock jumps. Initial-midpoint UTC estimates below are approximate, not guaranteed bounds.

productTransport.scope: Case restore logs identify the same product artifact and downloaded ZIP digest; independent archived product inventory is recorded separately.
